title: Scheduler Decision Stability and Priority-Aware Validation
method: Live scheduler API using synthetic metric snapshots; five repetitions per static scenario and six-step threshold-jitter sequence for each priority. No inference workloads or deployment changes.
scenario_groups: CPU below/at/above threshold for Low, Medium, High
RAM below/at/above threshold for Low, Medium, High
Disk at 85.0% and above at 85.1% for all priorities
Poor network with Edge overloaded: High=EDGE, Low/Medium=QUEUE
interpretation: All tested decisions matched the rule-based expected outcomes. The alternating jitter sequence demonstrates threshold-driven placement oscillation because the current policy has no hysteresis/debounce state. This test does not establish mitigation of oscillation.
limitations: Synthetic metric inputs, not live resource telemetry.
Scheduler decision endpoint validation only; no inference execution.
No ML policy or autonomous learning evaluated.
No deployment, pod, or scheduler configuration changes.
